  • Low Crime Rate: Neighborhoods with low reported thefts, burglaries, and violent crimes.
  • Well-Lit Streets & Public Spaces: Adequate lighting minimizes risks, particularly during nighttime.

Safety Tips While Living in Bangalore

To live in a busy city like Bangalore, some extra care must be taken with regards to safety. Here are a few essential tips to help you remain safe.

2) Use Bangalore Police's Suraksha App, and bookmark emergency numbers like 100 (police) and 108 (ambulance).

Before you settle into your home, study the neighborhood, visit during various times, and talk to locals to experience safety firsthand. With precautions in hand, you can experience Bangalore's vibrant culture while residing in a safe, accessible, and thriving neighborhood. Safe and happy house hunting!
